The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, May 14, 2018 Posted by admin on May 14th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
 up +56 points.
Friday the Dow was up +91.64 (+0.37%) at 24,831.17.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.45%.
There were 19 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Verizon (VZ) +3.01% and Merck(MRK) +2.81%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Cisco (CSCO) -0.80% and Apple (AAPL) -0.76%.
This week we get earnings reports from Home Depot (HD), Cisco (CSCO) and Wal-Mart (WMT). See the earnings section below.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended higher.
